newsitem.title: UK: Iraq tells OPEC May output/supply 1.489 mln bpd.
newsitem.headline: Iraq tells OPEC May output/supply 1.489 mln bpd.

text.p: Iraq told OPEC it produced 1.489 million barrels per day (bpd) in May, the OPEC News Agency (OPECNA) said on Monday.
The data were submitted directly to OPEC headquarters in Vienna.
Iraq said its supply to market was also 1.489 million bpd, well below April's 1.7 million bpd but still in excess of its OPEC quota of 1.2 million.
Last week, the United Nations renewed an oil-for-food deal with Iraq allowing Baghdad to sell another $2 billion worth of oil over six months to raise money for humanitarian imports.
Exports during the first period of the deal were concluded some 10 days ahead of the scheduled end on June 7.
Libya told OPEC it produced 1.392 million bpd in May, supplying 1.394 million to market. Nigeria pumped 1.87 million bpd and Venezuela 2.407 million bpd, OPECNA reported.
